scope: Strict location-scoped stakeholder identity proposal and independent decision Gateway contracts
checks_cover: Exact strict proposal and decision request fields, enums, UUIDs, confidence bounds, and precision are published in OpenAPI
Malformed and undeclared proposal/decision fields return generic no-store errors before service access
Proposal success preserves its 201 response and decision remains an independent review operation
Proposal and decision response fields are exact; terminal decisions cannot return the proposed status
Proposal and decision service responses are schema-validated and malformed output fails closed without exposing details
The service still owns signed location context, transaction handling, and independent-review enforcement
rollback: Revert the route models, strict write contracts, focused tests, and evidence entry; no database rollback is required.
